productFit.name: Primos Trigger Stick Gen3 Tall Tripod
productFit.reason: Sold in the Netherlands as "Primos trigger stick gen 3 schietstok 3-poot" (Mets Jachthuis, Jachtloods).

localFacts.fact: CBS: men aged 20 or older in the Netherlands were on average 1,81 m tall in 2018; on the legs alone the Leupold (188 cm) and Fatboy (182 cm) reach that, the Vortex (171 cm), Primos (157 cm) and BOG (151 cm) do not.
KLM allows hand baggage of max. 55 x 35 x 25 cm; folded, the Vortex (71 cm), Leupold (74 cm), Fatboy (67 cm) and BOG (78 cm) are all longer.
Dutch hunting shops sell the Primos Trigger Stick Gen 3 as a "schietstok 3-poot" with a removable 360-degree V rest, so it can also take a camera.
all4shooters measured the BOG DeathGrip Infinite CF at 2925 g and 78 cm packed, clamp about 150 cm high at full extension; sold in the EU by STROBL.CZ.
A German seller lists the Vortex Radian Carbon ball head kit at 25 kg max. load (leveling head kit 20 kg).
Local terms: schietstatief / schietstok (driepoot), balhoofd, nivelleerbasis, Arca-Swiss-rail, Picatinny-rail, houding (liggend, zittend, knielend, staand).

localPainPoints.pain: A tripod shooting stick has to stand firm before you lean on it.
localPainPoints.fix: Press the feet in (spikes on soft or frozen ground), legs wide, pack on the hook, then load the rifle.

quotes.text: De ondersteuning installeert u eenvoudig door deze eerst stevig in de grond te nestelen

localPainPoints.pain: Changing height by moving the legs closer or wider changes stability.
localPainPoints.fix: Reach shooting height on the thickest sections at the widest stop that works; the narrowest stop only for standing.

quotes.text: Pas de hoogte van een driebenige-schietstok aan door de benen verder uit elkaar of juist dichter bij elkaar te plaatsen.

localPainPoints.pain: With twist locks you cannot see whether a lock is open or closed.
localPainPoints.fix: Vortex and BOG use twist locks (English specs): pull each leg before the rifle goes on.

quotes.text: Nadeel is dat je niet goed ziet of de sluiting los of vast is.

localGain.point: Standing height checked against the Dutch average (1,81 m): only Leupold and Fatboy reach it on the legs.
